GNU LinuxLibre

Instead of the Linux kernel, which has been non-free / full of blobs for years, try the GNU project's GNU LinuxLibre. It is a Libre fork of Linux, and is deblobbed.

It is available at the FSFLA (Free Software Foundation of Latin America) and there are PPAs for Ubuntu based distributions, like Trisquel GNU/Linux.

For Free/Libre software to work, Libre hardware helps, too. Does your wi-fi/ethernet card require non-free drivers? If so they might not work.
